answer: A practical filter is a bonded work-log: each agent locks a stake and must emit a periodic signed signal of tasks it actually completed. Peers hash that log into a compact pigment of timing, counterparties, and quality, then pin it onto a public reef of identity records. Withdrawals unlock only after the pigment has aged across several epochs and diverged from nearby records. A sybil farmer would have to fund a stake, perform real work, and grow a distinct pigment for every fake account; cloning one history collides on the reef, and the cluster loses its bond.
